scope: Targeted gap review against current README: Canada and Canadian subsets of regional/global resources. Not an exhaustive census. No new data ingestion or GEE runtime verification performed.
rules: Source/paper access is distinguished from file-level validation, licences, redistribution rights and geolocated data availability.
Native predictor grid, output grid and plot/core support are separate.
Do not count overlapping original observations twice.
Carbon concentration, biomass, extent, flux, standing stock and sequestration potential are distinct.
Sothe 0–1 m remains the maintainer working assumption; Li remains variable modelled peat depth.

resources.name: Can-Peat Canadian Peatland Data Portal
resources.geographic_context: Canada; dataset-specific local/regional coverage
resources.spatial_support: No raster grid
resources.depth_or_pool: Stock, peat properties, depth, flux and ancillary records
resources.access_status: Public discovery portal; access varies by linked dataset
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Browse original records at https://waterlooclimatedata.ca/canpeat/metadata-list . This is not the NRCan 1,217-site Peat Profile Database already uploaded, nor C-PEAT. Li is already indexed there: do not count it twice. The Can-Peat integrated national-map activity page describes a project, not a verified released map.

resources.name: Shaw et al. Canadian upland forest soil profile and carbon stocks database
resources.geographic_context: Canadian upland forests
resources.spatial_support: 3,253 pedons; 16,167 horizon records in source publication
resources.depth_or_pool: Organic horizons plus mineral soil to 100 cm; preserve original depth datum
resources.access_status: DataS1 ZIP and metadata supplement linked by publisher
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Important missing named source. NFI contributes some stock summaries without matching horizon records; do not expect every pedon in every table. Check overlap with NPDB/WoSIS/McNicol and coordinate-quality flags. Publisher describes noncommercial reuse and commercial permission requirements; verify distribution terms before hosting.

resources.name: McNicol et al. NPCTR soil-carbon database and raster
resources.geographic_context: Coastal British Columbia and southeast Alaska; restrict Canadian analysis to actual BC footprint
resources.resource_type: ground profiles plus predicted SOC map
resources.spatial_support: About 1,300 profile descriptions; reported map grid 90.5 m
resources.depth_or_pool: 1 m mineral soil plus overlying organic horizons; not automatically 1 m below peat/forest-floor surface
resources.access_status: Dryad XLSX, raster archive, README; database revised 2024
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Preserve measured/estimated flags and coordinate-quality fields. The current README says water/ice are unmasked while the copied Methods text describes masking: inspect the actual raster. Reconcile source-profile overlap before counting independent sites.

resources.name: Arsenault et al. temperate peatland bathymetry and C/N/P stocks
resources.geographic_context: Argenteuil, Québec; 28 fens, bogs and forested peatlands
resources.resource_type: field observations and regional/site stock analysis
resources.spatial_support: Site peat-depth interpolation to 1 m² cells; not a wall-to-wall 1 m regional carbon raster
resources.depth_or_pool: Variable peat-basin depth, not fixed 1 m SOC
resources.access_status: Paper links Zenodo; Can-Peat provides a version-specific link; direct archive retrieval failed in this review
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Can-Peat links version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17065342. Confirm version and available files before ingestion. Record detailed bathymetry separately from regional upscaling and LiDAR covariate grids.

resources.name: Martens and Kreyling coastal BC peatland carbon
resources.geographic_context: Read Island and Porcher Island, coastal BC; six peatlands
resources.resource_type: local field study and linked data archive
resources.spatial_support: Plot/core measurements; no uniform raster verified
resources.depth_or_pool: Peat and biomass pools; preserve sampled depths and pool definitions
resources.access_status: Paper links Zenodo; archive landing retrieval failed in this review
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Paper combines new samples with existing NRCan peat observations. Separate new observations from reused Peat Profile Database records. Paper labels archive above-/belowground biomass data: inspect actual files before assuming all profile and stock inputs are present.

resources.name: PEATGRIDS
resources.geographic_context: Global peatlands including Canada; not a Canada-specific regional model
resources.resource_type: predicted peat thickness, properties, stock and uncertainty
resources.spatial_support: Reported 1 km output
resources.depth_or_pool: Full modelled variable peat thickness; depth-resolved BD and carbon-content inputs
resources.access_status: Zenodo release 2.0.1 and documented Awesome GEE assets
resources.gee_status: documented_catalogue_ids_not_runtime_tested
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Catalogue: https://gee-community-catalog.org/projects/peatgrids/ . Distinguish per-area stock from total carbon per pixel. Version 2.0.1 clarifies stock units; verify encoding, units, masks and coverage against release before conversion. Shared training cores may overlap our compilations.

resources.name: Hugelius et al. northern peatland maps, version 2
resources.geographic_context: Northern Hemisphere north of 23° N; includes Canada
resources.resource_type: peat extent, depth and carbon reference grids
resources.spatial_support: 10 km projected GeoTIFF or 0.1° WGS84 GeoTIFF/NetCDF; coarse synthesis
resources.depth_or_pool: Peat depth and depth-derived stock; preserve peat fractions and area denominator
resources.access_status: Bolin Centre download
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Distinct from NCSCDv2. Retain native units (carbon fields labelled hg/m²), peat fractions and version. Do not present 10 km cells as local 30 m evidence.

resources.name: C-PEAT Global Peatland Carbon Database v.2025
resources.geographic_context: Global; Canadian subset must be selected and counted
resources.spatial_support: 267 cores globally in data paper; Canadian count not established
resources.depth_or_pool: Variable core depths and age models
resources.access_status: PANGAEA archive and ESSD data paper
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Distinct from Can-Peat and NRCan peat. Country/site and original-core matching needed to avoid duplicate records. Preserve measured properties, chronological support and accumulation rates separately from stock.

resources.name: Lamping et al. coastal forest biomass and structure maps
resources.geographic_context: Coastal southern Alaska and British Columbia
resources.spatial_support: 30 m maps
resources.depth_or_pool: Live aboveground and species biomass; inspect release attribute list for snag biomass, not a complete ecosystem carbon stock
resources.access_status: Zenodo GeoTIFF archive
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Biomass is not carbon without a documented conversion. Publication reports snag-biomass attributes; verify released band/file coverage. Underlying true forest-plot locations are confidential; do not infer open geolocated training data from open maps.

resources.name: Gross et al. central Alberta agroforestry carbon pools
resources.geographic_context: Central Alberta hedgerows, shelterbelts, grassland and adjacent cropland
resources.resource_type: field carbon-pool tables plus separate GHG files
resources.spatial_support: Local study; no raster output established
resources.depth_or_pool: Live biomass, deadwood and soil SOC (study includes approximately 1 m total soil); inspect table-specific depths
resources.access_status: Dryad downloadable CSV tables
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Useful multi-pool addition. SoilOCN.csv, LiveBiomassC.csv and Woodland.csv are stock-related; keep GHG flux files separately. Verify coordinates, sampled areas, depth increments and units before GEE upload.

resources.name: Pyle and Bork pasture composition, management and soil properties
resources.geographic_context: 102 pastures around Edmonton, Alberta
resources.spatial_support: Local pasture sampling; coordinates withheld by privacy agreement
resources.depth_or_pool: Upper 15 cm mineral-soil carbon concentration and ancillary properties; not ready-made SOC stocks
resources.access_status: Dryad CSV and README; locations explicitly unavailable
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Suitable for non-spatial synthesis and management context. Carbon concentration alone is not stock; do not fabricate coordinates or treat % total C as necessarily organic C. Bulk density/stock completeness needs inspection.

resources.name: Southern interior BC pasture soil-carbon modelling study
resources.geographic_context: 65 grazed/non-grazed pastures, southern interior British Columbia
resources.spatial_support: MODIS NDVI 250 m versus handheld 1 m measurements; these are predictor supports
resources.depth_or_pool: SC study depth/stock definitions need full source extraction
resources.access_status: Paper found; standalone downloadable ground-data archive not verified
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Study identifies elevation, precipitation and NDVI as important predictors in this context. Do not infer national proof, an open point dataset or a wall-to-wall stock map from the abstract.

resources.name: Chizen et al. drained prairie pothole wetland SOC
resources.geographic_context: Saskatchewan Prairie Pothole Region; 33 drained wetlands in research description
resources.spatial_support: Wetland/core/depth increments; no public map verified
resources.depth_or_pool: SOC plus particulate and mineral-associated fractions; preserve sampled depth/time
resources.access_status: Paper and supplement; raw data stated available from authors
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Author-request resource, not verified public geolocated tables. Request/locate data and compare independent wetlands and repeated samples. Do not substitute sequestration rates for stocks.

resources.name: Pendea et al. Lake Simcoe freshwater wetland soils
resources.geographic_context: Lake Simcoe watershed, Ontario; four swamps and four marshes
resources.resource_type: soil/core observations and dated accumulation analysis
resources.spatial_support: Eight 50 cm cores; no raster
resources.depth_or_pool: Fixed upper 50 cm sampling plus dated-horizon stock/rate subsets
resources.access_status: Paper links public Borealis V1; archive file-level retrieval not tested
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Adds nutrient-rich freshwater marshes/swamps. Keep 0–50 cm stocks separate from age-defined intervals and carbon accumulation rates; preserve hydrological class.

resources.name: Chastain/Kohfeld et al. Clayoquot Sound salt-marsh cores
resources.geographic_context: Clayoquot Sound, BC; seven salt marshes
resources.resource_type: downloadable core layers and stock summaries
resources.spatial_support: 34 cores collected in 2016; site support, no raster
resources.depth_or_pool: 20 cm, basal-peat and dated-horizon stock supports
resources.access_status: PANGAEA bundle and tab-delimited datasets; CC BY 4.0 stated
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Retain compaction corrections and measured versus LOI-derived carbon. Likely overlap with Janousek compilation: cross-match original study/core IDs before counting additional sites.

resources.name: Cowichan Estuary blue carbon study
resources.geographic_context: Cowichan Estuary, Vancouver Island, BC
resources.spatial_support: Habitat/core support; no verified public stock raster
resources.depth_or_pool: Top 20 cm organic and inorganic sediment carbon, plus vegetation
resources.access_status: Paper and supplement; raw data promised by authors, standalone archive not verified
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Salt marsh, eelgrass, mudflat and oyster-bed comparisons. Keep organic/inorganic carbon and living biomass distinct; cross-check against Janousek before treating as new cores.

resources.name: Epstein et al. Canadian continental-margin sediment OC
resources.geographic_context: Canadian continental margin including Pacific, Atlantic and Arctic regions
resources.resource_type: predictive sediment maps, uncertainty, samples and code
resources.spatial_support: 200 m output; predictor sources can be coarser
resources.depth_or_pool: Standing stock in upper 30 cm seabed sediment; density is a separate quantity
resources.access_status: Paper links Borealis GeoTIFFs and source review data/code
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: High-priority new pool. Record seafloor area/rock mask, depth basis and approximated uncertainty; do not add overlapping terrestrial/coastal products without checking footprints.

resources.name: Blue Carbon Canada publications and data directory
resources.geographic_context: Canadian coastal/marine research
resources.spatial_support: Resource-specific
resources.depth_or_pool: Sediment, coastal vegetation, kelp, habitat and flux resources
resources.access_status: Public directory; individual files/access vary
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Use to improve Atlantic/Arctic coverage and locate source archives. Habitat extent and kelp productivity are not themselves stored-carbon stock. Do not assume every listed project has a downloadable national stock raster.

resources.name: ECCC freshwater sediment-quality observations
resources.geographic_context: 20 lakes across Canada, sampled 2011–2016
resources.spatial_support: One to three sampling locations per lake
resources.depth_or_pool: Organic and inorganic carbon concentrations; no complete stock inventory established
resources.access_status: Open Government CSV resources; OGL-Canada stated
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Ancillary lake-carbon observations only. Stock calculation needs sampled thickness, density, geometry and suitable sediment spatial representation; concentration cannot simply be summed.

resources.name: Parks Canada Carbon Atlas — forests of national parks
resources.geographic_context: 31 Canadian national parks, report summaries 1990–2020
resources.spatial_support: Park-level summaries; no reusable raster verified
resources.depth_or_pool: Biomass and dead organic matter, including deadwood/litter/soil
resources.access_status: Public government report; machine-readable spatial archive unverified
resources.gee_status: No GEE asset ID verified in this review; use provider source.
resources.cautions_and_next_action: Useful pool-definition and regional benchmark reference. Modelled accounting is not new independent field observations or pixel validation.
